headline: Ireland Extends Short-Stay Visa Waiver for UK Travelers Through 2026
summary: Ireland extended its Short-Stay Visa Waiver Programme until December 31, 2026. The scheme permits eligible foreign nationals entering from the UK to visit Ireland without a separate Irish visa.
why: Cross-border entry arrangements support tourism, aviation, and hospitality revenue within the Common Travel Area between Ireland and the United Kingdom.

impacts.name: Ireland
impacts.why: Maintaining visa waiver continuity supports international visitor inflows into Ireland.
